block.guhs.guhparkour_startpaaltje.lore: Ready, set, go! ...after a little nap, Nyeg.
block.guhs.guhparkour_startpaaltje.uitle: Click toys and obstacles with it: 1, 2, 3... up to the Finish Post. Then put it down.
block.guhs.guhparkour_finishpaaltje.lore: Whoever gets here has earned a nibble.
block.guhs.guhparkour_finishpaaltje.uitl: The last piece of a Guh Parkour: the clock stops here.
block.guhs.guhparkour_horde.lore: Hup, over you go! Pulling in your tummy doesn't help.
block.guhs.guhparkour_horde.uitleg: Obstacle for a Guh Parkour: your guh jumps over it.
block.guhs.guhparkour_springplank.lore: Boing! For just a moment, a little chonk can fly.
block.guhs.guhparkour_springplank.uitleg: Obstacle: a run-up, boing, and a long way through the air. Keep three blocks free behind it.
block.guhs.guhparkour_kruiptunnel.lore: A guh goes in and a bump travels through.
block.guhs.guhparkour_kruiptunnel.uitleg: Obstacle three blocks long: your guh crawls through it as a bump.
block.guhs.guhparkour_slalompaaltjes.lor: Left, right, left... which way was it again, Nyeg?
block.guhs.guhparkour_slalompaaltjes.uit: Obstacle three blocks long: zigzag between the poles.
block.guhs.guhparkour_evenwichtsbalk.uit: Obstacle three blocks long: your guh shuffles across and sometimes falls off. No worries: it climbs right back on.
block.guhs.guhparkour_knabbeltafeltje.lo: Mandatory pit stop. Eat first, run later.
block.guhs.guhparkour_knabbeltafeltje.ui: Obstacle: your guh calmly eats a nibble here first. It costs time, but it has to be done, Nyeg.
block.guhs.guhparkour_scorebord.lore: Who is the fastest little chonk in the land?
block.guhs.guhparkour_scorebord.uitleg: Shows, per guh, the laps and the best lap time of the Start Post nearby.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.hint.obstakel: This belongs to a Guh Parkour: click it with a Start Post in your hand, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.hint.finish: The Finish Post: click it last with your Start Post.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.niet_van_jou: This Start Post belongs to %1$s. Looking is fine, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.finish: Finish added! The route has %1$s pieces. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.eruit: %1$s was taken out of the route
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.vol: The route is full: a guh can't remember more than %1$s pieces, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.te_ver: That is more than %1$s blocks from the start. A guh doesn't trot that far, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.geplaatst: The Start Post is up! A route of %1$s pieces. Right-click to put guhs on it.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.geplaatst_te_: The Start Post is up, with %1$s pieces. %2$s were too far away: they are left out.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.leeg_geplaats: The Start Post is up! Sneak + right-click it, then click the pieces: 1, 2, 3...
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.modus_aan: Laying out the route: click the pieces in order (1, 2, 3...) and the Finish Post last. Clicking a piece again takes it out. Click the Start Post when you're done.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.uitzet.modus_uit: Done laying out: the route has %1$s pieces.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.rondje.record: %1$s: lap %2$s in %3$s. A new record, Wahoog!
gui.guhs.guhparkour.bord.geen_paal: This scoreboard doesn't belong anywhere yet: put it within 32 blocks of a Start Post.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.bord.gekoppeld: Scoreboard linked to the Start Post.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.bord.leeg: No laps run yet. The guhs are probably still chonking about.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.onder.klaar: Guhs run their laps until you take them off
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.onder.geen_fi: No Finish Post yet: the clock now stops at the last piece
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.leeg: No pieces yet. Click 'Click pieces' and then click toys and obstacles in the world: 1, 2, 3... and the Finish Post last. The slide, the seesaw, the swing and the fluffy tunnel join in too!
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.geen_guhs: Pick a guh above and put it on the route.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.tip.weg: This piece is gone. Guhs skip it; take it out of the route.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.tip.hapert: A guh couldn't get here: that lap didn't count. Is something in the way?
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.tip.finish: The Finish Post always stays the last piece.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.melding.op: %1$s trots to the start. Hup, little chonk!
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.melding.op_le: %1$s is ready... but there is no route yet, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.melding.vol: Only %1$s guhs fit on a parkour at once.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.scherm.melding.gewis: All scores are wiped. A clean slate!
gui.guhs.guhparkour.gids.uitleg: Lay out a route past toys and obstacles with a Start Post and let your guhs run laps.
gui.guhs.guhparkour.gids.nog_niets: No guh has run a lap yet. Hup, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhparkour.gids.beste: The fastest laps of your guhs:
Make a &dStart Post&r and a &dFinish Post&r. Between them comes the &dGuh Parkour&r: a route past toys and obstacles that your guhs run laps on. Hold the Start Post in your hand and click the pieces in order: 1, 2, 3... and the Finish Post last. Then put the Start Post down (within 32 blocks of all the pieces).
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhparkour_hindernis: Build obstacles: the &dGuh Hurdle&r (hup, over you go) and the &dGuh Springboard&r (boing!). There are also the &dCrawl Tunnel&r (your guh travels through it as a bump), the &dSlalom Poles&r, the &dBalance Beam&r (oops, off... and back on) and the &dNibble Table&r: the mandatory pit stop. The slide, the seesaw, the swing and the fluffy tunnel can be part of the route too!
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhparkour_rondje.de: Right-click the Start Post, pick one of your guhs and put it &don the route&r (four fit at once). It trots to the start, uses every piece and then simply starts again, until you take it off. Let a guh run &6a whole lap&r. In the same screen you move pieces earlier or later in the route, or take them out.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhparkour_scorebord: Put a &dParkour Scoreboard&r within 32 blocks of your Start Post. It shows, per guh, the number of laps and the &6best lap time&r. Which of your guhs is the fastest? (And which one falls off the beam the most, Nyeg?)
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhparkour_groot.des: Build a route of &6at least eight pieces&r with a Finish Post at the end and let a guh run all of it. A route holds sixteen pieces. After that it has surely earned a nap.
